curatedMovie.curiosityHook: As Earp's devotion to the law hardens across the frontier, how heavy a toll will holding the line in Tombstone demand?
curatedMovie.description: Guided by an unbending devotion to family and law, Wyatt Earp traverses frontier towns from Wichita to Dodge City and Tombstone, joining his brothers and Doc Holliday to confront the violent Clanton and McLaury gangs.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Measured, somber, and emotionally weighty, demanding sustained focus for a serious frontier epic.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Lawrence Kasdan mounts an expansive Western drama that grounds frontier conflict in grave family loyalties across an ambitious, sweeping runtime.
